landing.hero_subtitle: The cultural challenge of the Colonial Zone
landing.hero_body: You are about to embark on an adventure through the oldest streets of the New World. Each challenge hides a secret that only the most attentive will discover.
landing.what_body: Colonial Challenge is your interactive guide to discovering the secrets of the Colonial Zone like never before. This educational and digital platform reinvents cultural tourism, inviting you to explore iconic landmarks while solving fascinating riddles to unlock prizes and benefits. A modern and exciting new way to experience our history.
landing.cta_body: Join the most exciting cultural challenge in the Colonial Zone.
landing.cta_footer_body: JOIN THE MOST EXCITING CULTURAL CHALLENGE IN THE COLONIAL CITY!

steps.title: Register
steps.desc: Enter your name, age and email. You receive automatic confirmation.

steps.title: Choose language
steps.desc: Spanish or English. Everything adapts: questions, narrations, emails.

steps.title: Explore the map
steps.desc: See all the stops. Check which ones you've completed and which are left.

steps.title: Choose nearby stage
steps.desc: All participants will begin their adventure together at the First stop or challenge.

steps.title: Listen to the story
steps.desc: Narration in colonial chronicler style in your chosen language.

steps.title: Answer the challenge
steps.desc: Educational questions about the site + fun facts between each one.

steps.title: Spin the prize wheel
steps.desc: After completing a stage, spin the wheel. The system checks your age.

steps.title: Redeem your prize
steps.desc: Receive a unique code by email to present at the redemption point.

register.title: Join the cultural challenge!
register.subtitle_2: Tell us a bit about you
register.rules_body:
• Allow location access to play.
• Get within 12 meters of the spot to unlock the trivia.
• Pay close attention to the audio challenges at each location.
• Answer correctly to earn rewards.
• Pick up your prizes in person at participating stores.
• Sign up with your email once for unlimited gameplay.

map.tour_turi_body: Welcome! I'm Turi, your personal tour guide. Together, we will explore the Colonial City and uncover the most fascinating facts about the First City of the New World.
map.tour_stages_body: Explore the checkpoints, progress through the levels, and beat the Colonial Challenge!
map.tour_fullscreen_body: Turn on full screen to get the most out of the map.
map.tour_profile_body: The adventure starts soon! Go to your profile, check the leaderboard, and learn the rules of the challenge.
map.demo_slide1_body: Tap a stop to see its history. Listen with "NARRATION" or read it before answering.
map.demo_slide2_body: Pick the right answer and tap "CHECK". The more you get right, the more points you earn!
map.demo_slide3_body: Complete a stage and spin the wheel to win a surprise prize from the Cultural Challenge.
map.demo_slide4_body: You'll receive a unique code to redeem at participating stores. Keep it safe!

map.no_prize_subtitle: Don't give up — let's move on to the next challenge!
map.quiz_failed_msg: You must answer all challenges correctly to complete this stop.
map.ranking_subtitle: The toughest pirates of the Caribbean
map.no_prizes_sub: Complete cultural challenge stops to earn prizes
map.app_desc: Turizoneando is a digital cultural gamification experience that connects tourists and citizens with the historic heritage of the Colonial Zone of Santo Domingo.
map.privacy_data_body: We collect your name, email address, country of origin, and in-app progress. We do not share your personal information with third parties.
map.privacy_location_body: Location is used only to show your position on the interactive map and calculate routes to Cultural Challenge stops. It is not stored permanently.
map.terms_use_body: By using Turizoneando you agree to participate in the Cultural Challenge under the established rules. The app is valid only within the Colonial Zone of Santo Domingo.
map.terms_prizes_body: Prizes are valid based on their expiry date and the availability of the participating establishment. One prize per stop, per registered user. Non-transferable.
